notes: All first-pass sentences covered (94). Search summaries blend pages, so symptom and cause sentences attributed to NHS main page may come from NHS-derived trust text; urls cited are pages returned by the searches. No survival statistics or doses appear. Removed: outlook sentences, 2024 PMC review, 'hard to predict' NF claim, meningioma membranes/three-grades wording, CRUK referral thresholds, absence-of-evidence sentences, targeted therapy, pituitary type. Child 48-hour referral verified against NICE NG12 (1.9.2, consider, newly abnormal cerebellar/central neurological function) and reattributed from CRUK. DVLA wording verified against GOV.UK (must tell DVLA; BT1/BT1V; risk categories). Edited sentences may have merged several first-pass sentences, so some newSentence fields point to the merged text. 'Within 48 hours' retained as a NICE-attributed number. Seizure 999 routes verified against NHS malignant symptoms page via search summary; A&E clause dropped. Meningioma sex pattern is NCI-attributed. Search 13 benign-treatment text is a summary of nhs.uk/conditions/benign-brain-tumour/treatment/.
